4gWhUy3VxOnCuSfQ.name: Skills
4gWhUy3VxOnCuSfQ.description: Choose any two skills from the Social or Knowledge skill groups — Instinct-keyed reading like Insight rounds out a Commander. Skip your Command Doctrine skill (Street-Fixer: Streetwise, Corp-Exec: Corporate, Bard: Performance); it’s granted separately. (Quick Build: Insight, Contacts.)

hcj1YC3aTtFzbWV9.name: Kit
hcj1YC3aTtFzbWV9.description: You can use and gain the benefits of a light Kit: no armor or light armor, and no heavy weapon. (Quick Build: Ghost or Duelist.)

VsRikpokRucoGVjB.name: Command Doctrine
VsRikpokRucoGVjB.description:
Choose your Command Doctrine: Street-Fixer (deals, favors, and the fixer’s web), Corp-Exec (credentials, protocol, and institutional power), or Bard (the techno-performer who moves a crowd). Each grants a skill. (Quick Build: Street-Fixer.)

Your doctrine is your subclass, and it determines many of the features you gain as you level.

uzchKZASfePaNpem.name: Signature Abilities
uzchKZASfePaNpem.description: You gain all four Commander signature abilities: Direct Ally, Mark, Read the Room, and The Right Word. None of them costs Influence; spending Influence enhances them.
